updates.note: Management reported full-year services revenue growth of 4.8% for FY26.
updates.quote: In FY'26, our services business achieved a growth of 4.8%.

updates.note: Management reported full-year consolidated revenue growth of 3.9% in constant currency for FY26.
updates.quote: In FY'26, we reported a consolidated revenue of $14.7 billion, an increase of 3.9% in constant currency.

updates.note: Management reported full-year operating margin (EBIT) of 17.2% (or 17.9% adjusted for restructuring) for FY26, largely landing around the guided 17% to 18% range.
updates.quote: Our operating margin for the full year was 17.2%, a dip of 107 basis points compared to last financial year. Excluding the restructuring costs, our full year margins were 17.9%

new_promises.statement: We guide FY27 revenue growth to be 1% to 4% in constant currency.
new_promises.quote: The revenue growth guidance for the full year is 1% to 4% in constant currency
new_promises.speaker: C. Vijayakumar

new_promises.statement: We guide FY27 Services revenue growth to be 1.5% to 4.5% in constant currency.
new_promises.speaker: C. Vijayakumar

new_promises.statement: We guide FY27 EBIT margin to be 17.5% to 18.5%.
new_promises.speaker: C. Vijayakumar

new_promises.statement: We are committed to return at least 75% of our Net Income back to shareholders over the next 5 years.
new_promises.quote: We are committed to return at least 75% of our Net Income back to the shareholders over the next 5 years.
new_promises.speaker: Shiv Walia
